title: Two chirp sources calling almost simultaneously
description: Two distinct chirp sources 200 m apart call a few seconds apart; S2 and S3 hear both. One animal heard by four stations must be one event, yet the two animals must stay two events even though their calls overlap in time. A station can contribute at most one record to each event.

expected.note: each source emits 3 calls; every call should be heard by all four stations
